transcript.answer: Lore runs all memory writes (episodes and memories) through `sanitizeContent()` / `redactSecrets()` before storing them. This privacy filtering strips API keys, JWTs, private keys, connection strings and bearer tokens. It applies to both the MCP tool path and the REST API path.
